reviews.title: Good 650w PC power supply
reviews.comment: I got this for a system I just built. I didn't use the most high end components but they still draw a lot of power. This installed easily and so far has been working great. It gives me all the connections needed with a few extra left over for further upgrades. I'm not a fan of the LED lighting but I can ignore it.
reviews.author: JJ

reviews.title: No-Name Brand Power Supply
reviews.comment:
It seems like no one has ever heard of this brand of power supply.  It has never been included in any general internet reviews.  With that in mind, I am not optimistic about its long-term usefulness.  But I have not had any problems with it so far.  I will try to come back and edit the review if it does give me trouble.
A couple of things to note:
The listing indicates that it is a non-modular unit, but the box indicates that it has a modular design.  The listing is correct.  All the cables are part of the unit and cannot be disconnected.  This makes me worry about whether my unit was put in the wrong box, if it actually meets the 80+ bronze standard, or even if it might be something completely different than what I ordered.  It is probably just fine, but having the box give wrong information is worrisome.
The case of the power supply is made of plastic.  I am sure it does not affect the operation of the power supply, but it is an indication of poor build quality.
reviews.author: James Lowe

reviews.title: Excelente opción
reviews.comment: Con total sinceridad tenia las expectativas promedio de un power cuando lo pedí pero el artículo me terminó impresionando para bien es una excelente opción para cualquier equipo que no tenga demasiado consumo yo lo e estado probando unas 8 horas continuas y no suena prácticamente el ventilador y el ventilador cuando prende las luces queda muy lindo y el envío fue muy rápido
reviews.author: JustinAC

reviews.title: Not bad.
reviews.comment: Got this power supply to replace one that went bad in my mini-ITX build. The power supply seems to be working fine so far. The majority of the cables are flat, which is great for smaller builds as it makes it easier to cable manage. The power supply only has a single PCIE cable for your GPU that has a secondary plug that's piggy backed on the single cable. I'm usually not a fan of this method, but for a lower powered system, it's fine.
reviews.author: Khoi Nguyen

reviews.title: Do your research
reviews.comment:
I’m uncertain about this power supply. I’ve had really bad experiences when buying not namebrand power supplies. You stick with what you know, especially if you have good experiences with certain brands. Especially with power supplies.  I’ll have to do some research on who actually makes this.
As of right now, it’s working fine. I have not pushed it to its limits yet. I’ve been using it for about a week now.
It looks like it’s a great value, depending on how long it’ll last. It’s easy to install. It looks good inside your case with the cabling.
It’s not super loud. Does not smell like a burning plastic factory……. Yet. I hope it never does. After using it for a week, it is maintaining wattage and powering all of my devices.
reviews.author: Honest A
